text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates bus service on Leslie Street, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval from City Council to install traffic control signals at the intersection of Leslie Street and Inn on the Park Drive. These signals are a condition of the development agreement for 1087, 1091 and 1095 Leslie Street (Inn on the Park). Traffic control signals are justified based on the anticipated vehicle traffic entering and exiting the development via the intersection.
City Council on November 26 and 27, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize traffic control signals at the intersection of Leslie Street and Inn on the Park Drive.
